races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: LEADING ROLE looked a useful prospect when bolting up at Nottingham last month and with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's colt will prove a tough nut to crack. John & Thady Gosden look to have a couple of live contenders and newcomer Ever Since shades the vote over Afif for the forecast spot. LEADING ROLE EVER SINCE (AUS) AFIF (FR)

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: AL LAHBAB made his odds-on stablemate work hard on debut at Newmarket last month so with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's colt is strongly fancied to go a place better. Kings Medal offered something to work on before tiring late on at Southwell recently so he can offer most resistance, with debutants Adventus Saxonum and Simply George taken to fight out third. AL LAHBAB KINGS MEDAL ADVENTUS SAXONUM
